content: The "Further action" byte of a vehicle identification response/ve- hicle announcement message shall contain the value 0x00, if any DoIPRoutingActiva- tion with DoIPRoutingActivationNumber equal to 0xE0 is configured and the according RoutingActivation was successfully performed.

The "Further action" byte of a vehicle identification response/ve- hicle announcement message shall contain the value 0x00, if any DoIPRoutingActiva- tion with DoIPRoutingActivationNumber equal to 0xE0 is configured and the according RoutingActivation was successfully performed.

The "Further action" byte of a vehicle identification response/ve- hicle announcement message shall contain the value 0x00, if any DoIPRoutingActiva- tion with DoIPRoutingActivationNumber equal to 0xE0 is configured and the according RoutingActivation was successfully performed.
